column1: # Tips: key <TAB> description <TAB> keywords. The key is the id of a ribbon control (CamelCase) or of a command (dotted). The description is one
# or two short sentences, at most 400 characters. The keywords are words separated by spaces, at most 32: the words people would type.
# In a column, \n is a new line, \t a tab and \\ a backslash. A row that breaks a rule is refused by `cargo xtask help check`.
